thread:
incidents-bot: Pager: High-sev alert — fallback/rollout interaction detected on route `smart-routing` (canary: smart-routing-v2). Error spike + region fallback loop. Paging @sam (oncall-sre) @maria (ml-platform) :rotating_light:

sam (oncall-sre): on it. severity? seeing 502/503s?

maria (ml-platform): yes. metrics show v2 canary is returning model-mismatch errors in eu-west, then requests fallback to v1 and get sticky routed back to the same problematic region — causing a loop and cache thrash.

jon (eng-runtime): logs show repeated KV cache evictions and `no-compatible-kernel` warnings when v2 nears 1k concurrent streams in eu-west. fallback_policy is `sticky` so session affinity persists to fallback variant.

ingrid (support): customer-facing: multiple customers reporting intermittent completions + higher latency; payments svc saw 15% increased errors starting ~1762009800. Support queue spiking.

maria (ml-platform): initial hypothesis: canary variant `v2-quant` was auto-selected for eu-west due to policy mapping but isn't compatible with eu-west runtime kernels. Shouldn't happen — misconfigured variant compatibility map.

sam (oncall-sre): mitigation options: 1) pause/rollback canary 2) flip fallback_policy -> stateless 3) reduce canary weight to 0. What's fastest?

maria (ml-platform): Fastest is flip fallback to `stateless` (no sticky affinity) so sessions won't repeatedly bounce. Then we can drain canary or rollback.

jon (eng-runtime): I can push stateless in <2m. will run the feature-flag toggle.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout `smart-routing-v2` currently at 5% (canary_id=cr-2345). Status: running.

sam (oncall-sre): go ahead jon, notify when done. I'm keeping page open.

jon (eng-runtime): flipping fallback_policy to `stateless` for route `smart-routing` now...

jon (eng-runtime): command run:
```
PATCH /api/v1/routing/smart-routing
{ "fallback_policy": "stateless" }
```

jon (eng-runtime): pushed. confirm: config_version=2026-03-15T03:03Z

maria (ml-platform): monitoring histograms. latency for route dropped 30% in 60s, error-rate falling. Good sign.

ingrid (support): observed reduced customer errors in the last 2m. ticket volume still elevated but trending down.

alex (product-ops): noted: why did canary pick incompatible variant? we need postmortem and fix mapping.

maria (ml-platform): root cause: a recent model catalog change added `v2-quant` as fallback-compatible for eu-west; that's incorrect — compatibility tags missing. Will revert mapping and add validation.

sam (oncall-sre): next step: do we want to pause the canary rollout to be safe? deploy-bot, can you pause/abort?

deploy-bot: Canary `cr-2345` paused by request. Rollout status: paused @ 5%.

jon (eng-runtime): recommend keeping canary paused and draining existing sessions from canary nodes. I'll reduce routing weight to 0 and set `drain=true` on canary pool.

jon (eng-runtime): commands executed:
```
POST /api/v1/canaries/cr-2345/actions
{ "set_weight": 0 }
POST /api/v1/canaries/cr-2345/actions
{ "drain": true }
```

maria (ml-platform): also adding a temporary guard: deny-selection for `v2-quant` in eu-west until compatibility is validated.

ingrid (support): quick customer impact summary for SOC/CS ops: peak affected requests ~12k over 10m window. Estimated customers impacted: 8 enterprise tenants, 2 with degraded SLAs. No data leakage.

sam (oncall-sre): SLO impact?

maria (ml-platform): route error-rate bumped past 5% SLO for ~8 minutes. We should file SLO incident and credit affected customers.

alex (product-ops): noted. I'll coordinate credits + customer comms with CS. Ingrid, please list top 3 affected tenants.

ingrid (support): listing: tenant-omega, acme-pay, travelio. I'll open tickets and share update.

sam (oncall-sre): handoff plan: I'm keeping incident owner for the next hour, then handing to jon for follow-up and rollback testing. Create follow-up actions: 1) catalog validation rule 2) add compatibility check in rollout pipeline 3) improve fallback policy test coverage 4) postmortem.

maria (ml-platform): already created PR for catalog change and added unit tests for compatibility tags. PR #482 in review.

jon (eng-runtime): I'll run a canary dry-run in staging with metrics gating after we add compatibility checks.

deploy-bot: Note: automated alerting suppressed for this route for 5m to avoid alert storms.

sam (oncall-sre): final status for now: canary paused, fallback_policy -> stateless, canary drained, customer errors subsiding. Severity downgraded to SEV-2. We're capturing all artifacts.

alex (product-ops): thanks team. action items assigned. I'll draft the customer update.

ingrid (support): will post customer messages and triage tickets.

sam (oncall-sre): handing incident to jon (eng-runtime) for remediation and validation. jon, please ack and take ownership.

jon (eng-runtime): acked. I'll own post-incident tasks and coordinate with maria on the catalog fix.

maria (ml-platform): adding follow-up: add a canary-fallback matrix test in CI to catch sticky fallback loops.

sam (oncall-sre): closing pager. please update the runbook with the commands we used and link the postmortem draft.

jon (eng-runtime): runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-fallback-loop (internal)

incidents-bot: Incident transitioned to "Monitoring". Incident ID: INC-20260315-042.

sam (oncall-sre): thanks all. leftover owners: jon (remediation), maria (catalog fix), alex/ingrid (customer comms). I'll add notes for postmortem.

ingrid (support): thanks — closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
